description: AlphaFold AF-Q9C5C0 structural check: pLDDT profile and active-site geometry of MPK18
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

m=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q9C5C0",timeout=90).json()[0]
print("AlphaFold model:", m["entryId"], "| version", m.get("latestVersion"), "| uniprotEnd", m["uniprotEnd"])
pdb=requests.get(m["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text

atoms=[dict(name=L[12:16].strip(),resn=L[17:20].strip(),resi=int(L[22:26]),
            x=float(L[30:38]),y=float(L[38:46]),z=float(L[46:54]),b=float(L[60:66]))
       for L in pdb.splitlines() if L.startswith("ATOM")]
A=pd.DataFrame(atoms); ca=A[A.name=="CA"].set_index("resi")
print("residues modelled:",len(ca))
kd=ca.loc[25:310]; tail=ca.loc[311:615]
print(f"\npLDDT whole={ca.b.mean():.1f} | kinase domain 25-310 mean={kd.b.mean():.1f} "
      f"(frac>70 {(kd.b>70).mean():.2f}, frac>90 {(kd.b>90).mean():.2f})")
print(f"pLDDT C-terminal extension 311-615 mean={tail.b.mean():.1f} (frac>70 {(tail.b>70).mean():.2f}) -> largely disordered")

def atom(i,n):
    s=A[(A.resi==i)&(A.name==n)]
    return s[["x","y","z"]].values[0] if len(s) else None
def d(a,b): return float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(a)-np.array(b)))
aa3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
     'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
S="".join(aa3[r] for r in ca.resn)
print("\nResidue identity check:", {i:S[i-1] for i in [32,34,37,54,149,150,151,153,156,169,170,171,187,188,189,197,198,199]})

print("\n=== alphaC glutamate: Lys-Glu ion pair that marks an active kinase conformation ===")
k=atom(54,"NZ"); c=[]
for i in range(60,105):
    if S[i-1]=="E":
        e=atom(i,"CD")
        if e is not None: c.append((i,d(k,e)))
c.sort(key=lambda t:t[1])
for i,dist in c[:5]: print(f"   K54 NZ -- E{i} CD : {dist:.2f} A")
ei,eD=c[0]
print(f"   -> alphaC Glu = E{ei}, ion pair {eD:.2f} A : {'FORMED (alphaC-in, active-like)' if eD<4.5 else 'NOT formed (alphaC-out)'}")

print("\n=== Catalytic network geometry ===")
P=[("K54 NZ","D169 OD1",atom(54,"NZ"),atom(169,"OD1"),"beta3 Lys to DFG Asp"),
   ("D151 CG","K153 NZ",atom(151,"CG"),atom(153,"NZ"),"HRD Asp to catalytic-loop Lys153"),
   ("D151 OD2","N156 ND2",atom(151,"OD2"),atom(156,"ND2"),"HRD Asp to HRD+5 Asn156 (Mg site)"),
   ("T187 OG1","Y189 OH",atom(187,"OG1"),atom(189,"OH"),"TDY phospho-acceptors"),
   ("D151 CG","T187 OG1",atom(151,"CG"),atom(187,"OG1"),"catalytic Asp to activation-loop Thr"),
   ("G32 CA","D169 CA",atom(32,"CA"),atom(169,"CA"),"P-loop to DFG across the ATP cleft")]
geo=[]
for n1,n2,a,b,lab in P:
    dd=d(a,b); geo.append(dict(pair=f"{n1} - {n2}",dist=round(dd,2),meaning=lab))
    print(f"   {n1:10s} -- {n2:12s} {dd:6.2f} A   {lab}")
pd.DataFrame(geo).to_csv("MPK18_alphafold_active_site_geometry.csv",index=False)

print(f"\npLDDT at catalytic residues: " + ", ".join(f"{r}{i}={ca.loc[i,'b']:.0f}"
      for i,r in [(32,'G'),(54,'K'),(151,'D'),(169,'D'),(187,'T'),(189,'Y'),(197,'A')]))
print(f"pLDDT at the degenerate CD-site block 310-331 = {ca.loc[310:331,'b'].mean():.1f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,4.8))
ax[0].plot(ca.index,ca.b,lw=0.7,color="#2a6fb5")
ax[0].axvspan(25,310,color="#9ecae1",alpha=.35,label="kinase domain 25-310")
for p,lab in [(54,"K54"),(151,"D151"),(169,"D169"),(187,"TDY")]:
    ax[0].axvline(p,color="#c0504d",lw=0.8); ax[0].annotate(lab,(p,102),fontsize=7,ha="center")
ax[0].axhline(70,color="grey",ls=":",lw=.8); ax[0].set_ylim(0,110)
ax[0].set_xlabel("residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax[0].set_title("AF-Q9C5C0: ordered kinase domain, disordered C-terminal extension")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
labs=[f"K54-E{ei}\nion pair","K54-D169\nDFG","D151-K153\ncat loop","D151-N156\nMg site","D151-T187\nact loop"]
vals=[eD,d(atom(54,'NZ'),atom(169,'OD1')),d(atom(151,'CG'),atom(153,'NZ')),
      d(atom(151,'OD2'),atom(156,'ND2')),d(atom(151,'CG'),atom(187,'OG1'))]
ax[1].bar(range(5),vals,color=["#2a6a46" if v<5 else "#c0504d" for v in vals])
ax[1].axhline(4.5,color="k",ls="--",lw=.9); ax[1].annotate("4.5 A salt-bridge cutoff",(2.1,4.9),fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(5)); ax[1].set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=8); ax[1].set_ylabel("distance (A)")
ax[1].set_title("MPK18 active-site geometry, AlphaFold model")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
